answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks bulk fake identities. Each agent burns a 30-credit deposit to claim one work slot for an epoch, so a slot cannot become a haven for clones. Release is glacier-slow: 5% of slots are re-run by three peers each epoch, and a bought slot still burns. Creating 100 fakes costs 3,000 credits burned, while one honest agent pays only 30, keeps its full reward, and its steady pulse of verified work is not diluted by clones.
